2608.03457.title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
2608.03457.paper_summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language modeling, yet the scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs remains poorly understood. We systematically characterize how optimization hyperparameters, compute allocation, and architecture scale for MoE dLLMs, identifying quantitative differences from scaling trends previously reported for AR models. Specifically, for optimization, the optimal nominal batch size grows faster, while the optimal learning rate decays more rapidly with compute. For model--data allocation, IsoFLOP analysis reveals a slight data-side tilt: the optimal token budget grows faster than activated model-side computation. For MoE architecture, larger scales increasingly favor larger expert pools at fixed activated capacity, while moderate expert granularity remains consistently effective and the preferred fraction of activated capacity assigned to shared experts remains stable across scales. Guided by these findings, we train LLaDA MoE v2, a 30B-A3B dLLM, from scratch on 23.5T tokens. With approximately 65\% as many pretraining tokens as Qwen3, LLaDA MoE v2 approaches Qwen3 on several knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks. After supervised fine-tuning alone, it outperforms SDAR Chat on seven of eight reasoning and coding benchmarks and remains close to Qwen3 on several tasks. These results establish practical scaling laws and design principles for MoE dLLMs.
2608.03457.paper_summary_zh: 擴散語言模型（dLLMs）提供了一種替代自回歸（AR）語言建模的方法，但混合專家（MoE）dLLMs的擴展行為仍然不太清楚。我們系統性地描述了優化超參數、計算分配和架構如何隨著MoE dLLMs的擴展而變化，並識別出與之前報告的AR模型擴展趨勢的定量差異。具體而言，在優化方面，最佳名義批次大小增長得更快，而最佳學習率隨著計算的增加而更快衰減。在模型-數據分配方面，IsoFLOP分析顯示出輕微的數據側傾斜：最佳的標記預算增長速度快於激活的模型側計算。在MoE架構方面，較大的規模越來越偏向於在固定的激活容量下擁有更大的專家池，而適度的專家粒度始終保持有效，分配給共享專家的激活容量的首選比例在各個規模中保持穩定。根據這些發現，我們從頭開始訓練LLaDA MoE v2，一個30B-A3B的dLLM，使用23.5T的標記。與Qwen3相比，LLaDA MoE v2的預訓練標記數量約為65\%。在幾個知識、推理和編碼基準上，LLaDA MoE v2接近Qwen3。僅在監督微調後，它在八個推理和編碼基準中的七個上超越了SDAR Chat，並在幾個任務中仍然接近Qwen3。這些結果確立了MoE dLLMs的實用擴展法則和設計原則。
